verdict.rationale: Pulumi's core primitive of "stacks" is confirmed hands-on (pulumi stack init dev, pulumi preview/up/destroy per stack) and state/config is backend-scoped per stack (pulumi-docs-4/14/23, pulumi-probe-6/7), which is exactly the mechanism developers use to separate dev/staging/prod environments. Missing for 10: explicit documentation citation showing pulumi config set per-stack values and a documented dev→staging→prod promotion workflow, and no independent community confirmation specifically about multi-stack environment management.
